title: Quaternion Gaussian Probes for Tensor Frobenius-Norm Estimation
summary: Large-scale tensors arising in science and engineering are often too large to form or store explicitly. Their multilinear contractions, however, can frequently be evaluated efficiently, which makes randomized Frobenius-norm estimation a practical alternative to exact computation. In this paper, we study estimation of the squared Frobenius norm of a real order-$d$ tensor from such contractions using independent real, complex, or quaternion Gaussian probes.
